text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer chained sentences with transitions like \"However,\" \"For example,\" and \"Sometimes\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The writing connects ideas more smoothly across sentences and paragraphs with clearer transitions and logical flow."},{"evidence":"\"Most of the times I believe... because they want their adive to impact them\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of complex sentence structure, even when errors remain."},{"evidence":"\"would make it harder for them to be motivated by a single voice\"","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"The essay explains its point with more extended cause-and-effect reasoning rather than mostly repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"\"My teachers, friends, family... had gave an advice that I heard and took their advice because it meant something to me\"","quality":"variety of expression","description":"The essay uses a wider range of phrasing and examples to restate the main idea without relying as heavily on the same wording."},{"evidence":"\"impact them in a positive or a negative way depends on who they ask advice from\"","quality":"precision of meaning","description":"The writing communicates nuanced relationships and contrasts more clearly, giving the reader a more specific sense of the idea."}]}
